summary: Steep, narrow street with houses beside the kerb and a no-parking sign.

drivers.seclusion: Dwellings line the east side within about 9 to 20 m along the whole stretch.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow sealed lane, kerb-to-fence on the east; no pull-off visible.
drivers.convention: A few cars park on the west side; the east kerb here has a No Parking Any Time sign.

flags: No Parking Any Time sign on this kerb
sun_shade: Heavy tree canopy over the northern end; open further south.
